LAREDO, Texas — Omar Hinojosa-Mariscal was arrested Thursday morning, October 22, 2026, at 7:31 a.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on three alleged second-degree felony counts of aggravated assault with a deadly weapon, according to Webb County booking records reviewed Thursday.

No arresting agency was listed in the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

No bond had been set on any of the three charges as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Omar Hinojosa-Mariscal is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
